note: Rewritten from the species-level description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alate, soldier and worker all described; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records not translated; explanatory figure captions and details of venation omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to yellowish brown, antennae uniformly coloured and paler than head capsule, mandibles pale reddish brown to dark brown. Cephalic setae sparse, body setae denser. Body length 4.25–7.70 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, wider posteriorly (head length to mandibular base 1.25–1.75, maximum width 1.10–1.38 mm, width/length index 0.73–0.87). Antennae 15–17-segmented; segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together, segment 4 shortest. Labrum ligulate, anteriorly tapering to a point. Mandibles falcate, slightly longer than half the head length (length 0.80–1.02 mm, left mandible length/head length index 0.55–0.66); left mandible with a small tooth slightly above the basal third (tooth/mandible length index 0.51–0.58); right mandible without a tooth. Postmentum subrectangular (length 0.80–1.15, width 0.50–0.60 mm), widest in the apical quarter, sides nearly straight behind it. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.45–0.60, width 0.83–0.98 mm), anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin weakly to distinctly concave; mesonotum narrower and metanotum wider, posterior margins of both nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellow to yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow; cephalic and body setae rather dense. Body length 3.9–5.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (head length to mandibular base 1.15–1.35, maximum width 1.20–1.48 mm). Antennae 17-segmented, segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 4. Postclypeus inflated, setose, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin rounded and deeply concave, posterior margin broadly or distinctly concave. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller, antennae 15–16-segmented; body length 2.9–3.6 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.70–0.85, maximum head width 0.80–0.95, pronotum length 0.30–0.35, width 0.50–0.55 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown to dark brown, antennae, labrum and postclypeus brown and paler than head capsule, pronotum and legs slightly paler than head capsule, abdominal tergites brown and slightly paler than postclypeus, sternites yellowish brown, wings pale brown. Cephalic and body setae dense. Body length (with wings) 22.5–26.75 mm, without wings 10.0–13.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (head length to mandibular base 1.67–1.83, width including compound eyes 2.15–2.40 mm), coronal suture indistinct. Fontanelle minute, punctiform, slightly raised, with a small paler area around and in front of it. Compound eyes round to suboval (maximum diameter 0.55–0.60, minimum diameter 0.48–0.53 mm), oblique, slightly above the lower margin of the head (distance from lower head margin 0.10–0.17 mm). Ocelli oval, medium-sized (long diameter 0.23–0.33, short diameter 0.15–0.23 mm), distance from compound eye about equal to the short diameter (0.15–0.20 mm). Antennae 19-segmented, segments 3–5 short and subequal, shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus inflated, setose, slightly less than half as long as wide (length 0.43–0.53, width 0.93–1.03 mm). Pronotum subtrapezoidal, with a paler T-shaped mark and shoulder spots at the middle (length 1.10–1.25, width 1.83–2.30 mm), anterior margin slightly incurved with a distinct median concavity, posterior margin convex and weakly concave medially; posterior margins of meso- and metanotum deeply concave. Wings pale brown, radial sector separated from the radius from near the proximal third to the middle of the membrane; forewing length 21.2–23.10, hindwing length 19.2–22.0 mm.
